policy_rules: Consultation fees per-family limit: SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 15,000 | SI 30,000 - 25,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Prescribed Diagnostics (Radiology, Pathology, Microbiology, Biochemistry) limit: SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 10,000 | SI 30,000 - 15,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Tele-consultation with Physician is unlimited across all SI options (Cashless only).
Pharmacy Expenses limit: SI 10,000 - Up to 2,500 | SI 20,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 30,000 - Up to 7,500 (Cashless & Reimb).
AYUSH (Ayurvedic & Homeopathy consults + pharmacy) limit: SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 15,000 | SI 30,000 - 25,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Physiotherapy limit: SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 10,000 | SI 30,000 - 15,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Infertility treatments (consultations + pharmacy) limit: SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 10,000 | SI 30,000 - 15,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Platinum HCK for Self & Spouse: Cashless HCK worth INR 8,000 (5,000 within SI + 3,000 deducted from OPD wallet). Reimbursement HCK cases capped at INR 4,000 per HCK.
Prescribed Dental limit: SI 10,000 - Not Covered | SI 20,000 - 3,000 | SI 30,000 - 5,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Prescribed Vision limit: SI 10,000 - Not Covered | SI 20,000 - 3,000 | SI 30,000 - 5,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Prescribed Vaccination/Immunizations/COVID booster limit: SI 10,000 - Not Covered | SI 20,000 - 3,000 | SI 30,000 - 5,000 (Cashless & Reimb).
Treatment that is cosmetic in nature is NOT covered.
Dental cosmetic surgery and routine dental care are NOT covered.
Benefits are limited to the Care Cashless OPD network only.
Claims must be submitted within 60 days of expense; in the last quarter of the policy, within 45 days. A 15-day post-expiry window is allowed for claim submission.
Requires main Group Health Insurance (GHI) policy details where OPD is opted as an optional extension.
No premium refund is made for any insured member who has incurred a claim during the policy period.
Addition/deletion window open for 60 days; mid-term inclusion allowed only for a child by birth or spouse after marriage.

policy.text:
INCLUSION CRITERIA CELL ===
INCLUSIONS (COVERED BENEFITS)
The following OPD benefits are covered, with per-family limits shown for each Sum Insured option:
1. Consultations - fees across all specialties: SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 15,000 | SI 30,000 - 25,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
2. Prescribed Diagnostics (Radiology, Pathology, Microbiology, Biochemistry): SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 10,000 | SI 30,000 - 15,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
3. Tele-consultation with Physician: SI 10,000 - Unlimited | SI 20,000 - Unlimited | SI 30,000 - Unlimited | Settlement: Cashless
4. Pharmacy Expenses (within OPD SI): SI 10,000 - Up to 2,500 | SI 20,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 30,000 - Up to 7,500 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
5. AYUSH (Ayurvedic & Homeopathy consults + pharmacy): SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 15,000 | SI 30,000 - 25,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
6. Physiotherapy: SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 10,000 | SI 30,000 - 15,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
7. Infertility treatments (consultations + pharmacy): SI 10,000 - Up to 5,000 | SI 20,000 - 10,000 | SI 30,000 - 15,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
8. 1 Platinum HCK each for Self & Spouse: SI 10,000 - HCK 8,000* | SI 20,000 - HCK 8,000* | SI 30,000 - HCK 8,000* | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
9. Prescribed Dental (exams, consult, fillings, crowns, extractions, X-ray, root canal): SI 10,000 - NA | SI 20,000 - 3,000 | SI 30,000 - 5,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
10. Prescribed Vision (consults, tests, medicines, spectacles/contact lens): SI 10,000 - NA | SI 20,000 - 3,000 | SI 30,000 - 5,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
11. Prescribed Vaccination (incl. COVID), Immunizations, COVID booster: SI 10,000 - NA | SI 20,000 - 3,000 | SI 30,000 - 5,000 | Settlement: Cashless & Reimb.
* Platinum HCK: cashless HCK worth INR 8,000 (5,000 within SI + 3,000 deducted from OPD wallet). Reimbursement HCK cases capped at INR 4,000 per HCK; self and spouse both eligible.
=== EXCLUSION CRITERIA CELL ===
EXCLUSIONS & KEY CONDITIONS
1. Any treatment that is cosmetic in nature shall NOT be covered.
2. Dental: Cosmetic surgery is NOT covered, and routine dental care is NOT covered.
3. At the INR 10,000 Sum Insured option, Dental, Vision and Vaccination benefits are NOT available (marked NA).
4. Benefits are limited to the Care Cashless OPD network only.
5. Claims must be submitted within 60 days of expense; in the last quarter of the policy, within 45 days. A 15-day post-expiry window is allowed for claim submission.
6. Requires the main Group Health Insurance (GHI) policy details where OPD is opted as an optional extension.
7. No premium refund is made for any insured member who has incurred a claim during the policy period.
8. Addition/deletion window is open for 60 days; mid-term inclusion allowed only for a child by birth or spouse after marriage.
Summary prepared from Policy Certificate A1553528 (Care Health Insurance Ltd). This is an indicative summary; the master policy wording governs in case of any discrepancy.
